description: This file is a shell script for testing the behavior of 'git config' with various configurations and inputs. It includes setup functions, test cases, and verification functions to ensure the correct handling of configuration entries.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the Git configuration with a section and key-value pair.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Verifies that a specific configuration key has the expected value.

methods.name: check_regex
methods.description: Verifies that a configuration key matching a regex has the expected value.
